{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders only
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Identify and remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
df_completed_clean = df_completed[df_completed['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Compute mean revenue of completed, non-QA orders
mean_revenue_clean = df_completed_clean['revenue_clean'].mean()

mean_revenue_clean"}
